BrandSensed rewards brand discovery and loyalty.

The BrandSensed token (BRND) is a native token on the Cardano blockchain. BRND provides value by influencing brand loyalty — It enables entities to represent, share and engage with brands.

BrandSensed utilizes the Cardano platform to unlock hidden value between individuals, retailers and brands, by rewarding brand discovery and loyalty.
